name: LSND detector
notes: Placed at site:lanl-lansce, owned by the 'facilities' lead and not yet created in data/atlas/ when this record was written; expected dangling reference until that lead lands.

placements.note: site:lanl-lansce is now created by the 'facilities' lead (previously an expected dangling reference). Quote corrected from a paraphrase to the verbatim §1.2 sentence; the value (30 m placement) is unchanged.
placements.quote: The detector was located about 30 m from the neutrino source and was shielded by the equivalent of 9 m of steel.

summary.plain: A cylindrical tank about 8 metres long holding 167 tonnes of mineral-oil scintillator, watched by more than a thousand light sensors, 30 metres from where the Los Alamos accelerator's beam produced neutrinos.
summary.technical: Approximately cylindrical tank (8.3 m long, 5.7 m diameter) filled with 167 t of mineral-oil-based liquid scintillator (0.031 g/l b-PBD wavelength shifter), instrumented with 1220 photomultiplier tubes detecting both Cherenkov and scintillation light; centred 30 m from the LAMPF/LANSCE A6 beam-stop neutrino source.

technology.quote: The detector was a tank filled with 167 metric tons of mineral oil (CH2), with a small admixture (0.031 g/l) of butyl PBD scintillant.
technology.value: Mineral-oil liquid scintillator detecting both Cherenkov and scintillation light, viewed by photomultiplier tubes
